feed.title: abox.tools
feed.subtitle: Free image compression, PDF, video, audio and text tools from abox.tools (A Box of Tools). Process files in your browser without processing uploads.

entry.title: Can an AI agent use these tools?
entry.summary: An agent can operate these browser tools. Check browser location, the agent vendor’s data handling, required permissions and any deliberate network feature.

entry.title: GIF Analyzer
entry.summary: Inspect GIF frames, delays, palettes and a byte-by-byte size breakdown in your browser. Check large or slow animations without uploading or changing the file.

entry.title: GIF Splitter
entry.summary: Extract GIF frames as PNGs, a ZIP or one sprite sheet in your browser. Keep transparency and save frame delays in a separate timing list. No upload.

entry.title: How to split a GIF into PNG frames
entry.summary: Extract GIF frames as complete PNGs, a ZIP or a sprite sheet. Keep transparency and a timing reference, rebuild an edited GIF, or convert the original to MP4.

entry.title: How to stack photos to reduce noise, remove people or make star trails
entry.summary: Choose Average for a cleaner burst, Median for moving people, or Lighten for star trails. Prepare consistent frames, align, compare and save, with RAW preview limits explained.

entry.title: Image Stacker
entry.summary: Stack photos to reduce noise, remove moving people or make star trails. Align frames and save PNG or JPEG in your browser. RAW files use embedded JPEG previews.

entry.title: Images to Video
entry.summary: Convert an image sequence to MP4 in your browser. Use one frame per image for renders and timelapses, or seconds per photo for a slideshow. No upload or account.

entry.title: Turn an image sequence or photo slideshow into MP4
entry.summary: Turn numbered render frames or timelapse photos into MP4, or make a photo slideshow. Choose frame holds or seconds, check order, and avoid cropped or mistimed output.

entry.title: What is actually inside a GIF
entry.summary: Inspect GIF frames, timing, disposal and palettes to explain a large or slow animation. Read the size breakdown, then choose frame extraction, editing or MP4.

entry.title: Does private browsing keep downloaded files private?
entry.summary: Separate private browsing history from saved files, check browser download behaviour, and practise with a harmless sample on your own device.

entry.title: Remote Camera
entry.summary: Watch a camera with Direct or optional Cloud relay, multiple viewers, shared video bandwidth, optional audio, viewer approval, camera switching and activity notifications.

entry.title: Share a Browser Tab
entry.summary: Share a browser tab with one approved viewer using Direct or optional Cloud relay. Invite by link, network discovery or a private group. No extension, audio or remote control.

entry.title: What an ordinary file can reveal about you
entry.summary: Use fictional receipts, screenshots and attendance lists to recognise private information, context and unnecessary disclosure before sharing a file.

entry.title: Where do your file copies go?
entry.summary: Follow originals, downloads, synced folders and shared copies so you know what remains after editing a file locally.

entry.title: Local Walkie-Talkie
entry.summary: Broadcast voice to up to ten receive-only browsers. Direct local connections or optional Cloud relay, with push to talk, hands-free speech and private group discovery.

entry.title: Share Text & Files
entry.summary: Send text or files between browsers with Direct or optional Cloud relay. Live updates, per-reader approval, no server content storage and no account.

entry.title: Voice Oncall
entry.summary: Let up to ten people send live voice to one host browser. Direct local connections or optional Cloud relay, with a pager password, push to talk and moderation.

entry.title: How to share a browser tab live without an extension
entry.summary: Show a browser tab to an approved viewer. Choose Direct on a reachable local network or an optional encrypted Cloud relay. No extension or remote control.

entry.title: How to watch a camera from another device
entry.summary: Reuse a phone for pets, entryways or DIY inspections. Approve the viewer and connect with Direct on a reachable local network or an optional encrypted Cloud relay.

entry.title: How to broadcast voice on a local network
entry.summary: Start a browser voice channel and invite listeners by link or nearby discovery. Direct is the default; an encrypted Cloud relay is available with explicit confirmation.

entry.title: How to receive live voice from nearby people
entry.summary: Open a browser voice pager with password admission and individual speaker controls. Choose Direct or an optional encrypted Cloud relay before hosting.

entry.title: Can blacked-out text be recovered?
entry.summary: Often, yes - because most black boxes are drawn over the text rather than put in its place. The three ways redaction fails, the copies a file keeps of its own past, and how to remove something so it stays removed.

entry.title: Does converting a photo remove its metadata?
entry.summary: Sometimes - and both outcomes surprise people. Which operations strip EXIF, which quietly keep it, why the screen shows no difference either way, and how to check a file instead of assuming.

entry.title: Extract receipt and invoice details from photos
entry.summary: How to check receipt OCR and crops, choose one email currency and manual or historical rates, then email compressed images with each converted value, the document count and a grand total.

entry.title: How can a web page work with the wi-fi off?
entry.summary: How a service worker caches browser tools, what an offline operation proves about local processing, and the network features and limits to check.

entry.title: How to Compress an Image Under a File-Size Limit
entry.summary: An upload form wants 500 KB and your photo is 4 MB. What a size limit really costs, which setting to move first, and why a PNG will not shrink the way a JPEG does.

entry.title: How to arrange multiple images into one picture
entry.summary: Make a collage, contact sheet or image strip: choose a grid, keep pictures whole or crop to fill, set the spacing and save a PNG, JPEG or WebP without uploading.

entry.title: How to check a bank statement CSV before you trust it
entry.summary: Check a converted bank statement CSV for wrong amounts, missing rows and misread dates. A worked example shows what running balances can and cannot prove.

entry.title: How to check a download against its checksum
entry.summary: How to check an MD5 or SHA-256 checksum on Windows, macOS and Linux or in your browser, what a match actually proves, and the mistake that makes the whole exercise pointless.

entry.title: How to clean up a voice memo before sending it
entry.summary: Cut the dead air and the false starts, then bring the level up to full scale. Two browser tools in a row, in the order that keeps the quality, and the recording never leaves your machine.
